_comment: LEVEL 3 (feature): in-app notifications — Notification model + current-user inbox (paginated), unread count, read / read-all. Other features call create_notification().
name: feature-notifications
description: In-app notifications: model, inbox endpoint (paginated), unread count, read / read-all. Other features call create_notification().
notes: After applying: 1) app.include_router(router), 2) make sure the model is imported (Base.metadata.create_all runs at app import), 3) call create_notification(db, user_id, title, body) from other features (e.g. after a long job). Requires feature-auth's get_current_user. Frontend: poll GET /api/notifications/unread-count for the badge, list via GET /api/notifications.
